cell.justification: The vendor's own support page states a dated Team plan support end of 31 March 2030, more than 12 months out, which is the level-5 condition.

selectors.exact: The Team plan is supported until 31 March 2030.

Mossnote Business: end of support announced for June 2026.

cell.justification: The help centre states every workspace exports to Markdown and JSON with a published JSON schema, meeting the level-5 condition; 'all data' is read from 'every workspace', and the API reference qualifies openness to bulk-endpoint exports (inferred from s1 and s2).

selectors.exact: Export every workspace to Markdown and JSON; the JSON schema is published in our API reference.
Exports produced by the bulk endpoint are documented in the open Notes Interchange schema, version 2.

missing.note: No retrieval record for this cell, so no Larkpad data-export source has been consulted.

cell.justification: The help centre documents notes and folders exporting to plain Markdown, but comments and attachments only as a proprietary .mossarchive bundle, so the cell sits between the level-3 anchor (proprietary only) and the level-5 anchor (all data open).

selectors.exact: Notes and folders export to plain Markdown. Comments and attachments export only as a .mossarchive bundle, readable by Mossnote.

cell.justification: The help centre states the team can move off Quillbase self-serve at any time, with completeness limited by the export formats the data supports, which is the level-3 condition.

selectors.exact: You can move your team off Quillbase yourself at any time. How complete the move is depends on the export formats your data supports; see the export guide.
Industry-leading support, there for your team whenever you need it.

missing.note: Retrieval searched the Larkpad homepage and press releases. The only match is general marketing language on the homepage, which states no end-of-support date or commitment for any plan.

cell.justification: The vendor help centre says leaving 'is handled by our paid Migration Services team' and the consultancy blog says a paid engagement is required above 50 seats; the level-1 condition is inferred from s1 and s2 read together, since the primary wording does not say 'required'.

selectors.exact: Moving an organisation off Mossnote is handled by our paid Migration Services team.
Mossnote requires a paid engagement with its own services team to migrate an organisation of more than 50 seats.

cell.justification: The help centre says the migration assistant moves the workspace self-serve, but only 'exactly what the export tool can produce, nothing more', a stated limit, which is the level-3 condition.

selectors.exact: Larkpad's migration assistant moves your workspace without any help from us, and it carries across exactly what the export tool can produce, nothing more.

cell.justification: The developer docs state every workspace, including comments and attachments, exports as JSON following the published OpenNotes 1.2 schema, meeting the level-5 condition; 'open' is read from 'published' and the schema name, not stated outright.

selectors.exact: Every workspace, including comments and attachments, exports as JSON that follows the published OpenNotes 1.2 schema.

cell.justification: downgraded (superseded): s1 vs s2. The vendor support page states 31 March 2030 and a later changelog entry extends Team plan support to 30 June 2031; both meet the level-5 condition.

selectors.exact: The Team plan is supported until 31 March 2030.
Team plan support has been extended to 30 June 2031.
